title: Industrial Painting
h1: Two-pack systems that hold up to real work.
summary: Industrial painting in Cairns. Two-pack systems, epoxy floors, factory roofs, warehouses, plant rooms and line-marking. Get a free quote.
intro: Factory floors, warehouses, plant rooms, workshop roofs. Hot-galv primers, two-pack epoxies, line-marking and a crew that won't blink at heights.
trust_line: Spray equipment, specialised coatings and a team trained in industrial finishes.

specs.title: Steel & structural
specs.body: Beams, columns, awnings, gantries. Rust converters, zinc primers, two-pack topcoats.

specs.title: Concrete & epoxy floors
specs.body: Warehouse, workshop, food-grade. Diamond grind, vapour-barrier prime, anti-slip and water-resistant epoxy systems.

specs.title: Factory & shed roofs
specs.body: Colorbond, zincalume, asbestos-encapsulation. Thermal-reflective topcoats to cool the building.

specs.title: Tank & vessel exterior
specs.body: Bulk storage, silos, fuel tanks. Inhibitor primers, UV-stable topcoats, full re-line on schedule.

specs.title: Line marking
specs.body: Carpark bays, warehouse aisles, safety zones. Crisp, hard-wearing acrylic and 2-pack lines.

specs.title: Mould & corrosion
specs.body: Cyclone-zone environments don't forgive shortcuts. High-pressure water cleaning, lead paint removal, then we treat, prime, and topcoat to last.

specs.title: Heights & access
specs.body: EWP, scaffold and ladder access — even the hard-to-reach areas, after hours, public holidays and weekends.

specs.title: Asbestos awareness
specs.body: Encapsulation systems for confirmed-low-risk roofs. We refer the rest to a licensed remover.

blocks.specs_lede: Sectors and surfaces we cover. If you're not on this list, ring us anyway — we usually know someone who can.
blocks.specs_close: We pick the system based on what the steel, concrete or roof actually needs — UV, immersion, abrasion, cyclone. Industrial-grade products only, and we tell you the spec on the quote in writing.
blocks.line_marking_lede: Acrylic for carparks, 2-pack for warehouses, hot-melt for traffic surfaces. Safety colours and durable line marking that stand up to real traffic.
blocks.cta_lede: We don't quote industrial blind. Send us the basics and we'll come past, walk the site, take notes and come back with a proper spec.

faqs.q: Does a fresh coat of paint improve the value of my home?
faqs.a: Creating a fresh new look for your property can increase its curb appeal and value if you are looking to sell. A neutral interior paint can make your property more appealing to a wider range of buyers, while a new exterior look can refresh your whole home. Painting both internally and externally has a great return on investment if you are selling. Keeping the roof clean can also help to improve the value of your home.

faqs.q: Can you help with lead paint removal?
faqs.a: Yes — our experienced team can handle lead paint removal and then re-paint with your choice of colours in a more health and environmentally friendly paint choice.
